notes.title: Update 1.2.1 - New levels and bugfix!
notes.notes:
Hello friends.
We have added new bonus levels to the game, for players who have already completed all the other levels and want more. Well, of course, we corrected several bugs that you reported to us at support@theneonboy.com, thank you for feedback.

We wish you a pleasant game!
Thanks for attention, your Neon Boy! :)

notes.title: The Neon Boy price reduction and upcoming update
notes.notes:
Hello friends.
Now The Neon Boy can be bought at a reduced price.
Soon, also, a new content update will be released, in which new bonus levels will be added :)

We wish you a pleasant game!
Thanks for attention, your Neon Boy! :)

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 - New levels
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!
The new update 1.2.0 is already available on Steam. In this update we added new levels in which you can play as a single player or with friends!

Also there are some minor edits and bug fixes!

Enjoy the game!
Thanks for attention, your Neon Boy :)

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Multiplayer beta
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32935452/220101877e463183e7d3ddec4ab03b1a43e7dd41.png

Hello everybody.
In this update the multiplayer mode for the neon boy, now it is possible to play with friends together.
The goal of the multiplayer game is to pass as many levels as possible faster than your friends. 
Multiplayer supports up to 4 players, at the moment you can only play with your friends on Steam.

This is a beta version of the multiplayer, check it out.
Thanks for attention, your Neon Boy! :)
